content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Assign Site Guest User Permission Set ## slug: assign-site-guest-user-permission-set ## seoTitle: Assign Site Guest User Permission Set ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (**IMPORTANT**) To use the following instructions, you must have Salesforce administrator access to Salesforce and Stripe. ::: 1. Navigate back to the Site you created. 2. Click **Public Access Settings**. ![H_02_21_assign site guest user per 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_21_assign%20site%20guest%20user%20per%201.png){height="" width=""} 3. Click the **View Users** or **Assign Users** button. 4. Click the link for the site guest user. ![H_02_21_assign site guest user per 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_21_assign%20site%20guest%20user%20per%202.png){height="" width=""} 5. Add the {{variable.PS_PT_SiteGuestUser}} permission set to this user's record. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![H_02_21_assign site guest user per 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_21_assign%20site%20guest%20user%20per%203.png){height="" width=""}
